name: TC-462: a COMPED order goes to print with nothing charged — and minting the card batch is what fulfilment does
description: On-behalf COMP → proof → Finalise (the line reads 'No charge', no price field, no comp switch, 'Comped — nothing is charged.', never 'Send for approval') → IN_PRODUCTION with total 0, paidAt set and no charge opened, a GiftCardBatch on the order, the 'on us' email, and Finance's comped cost up by the vendor cost.
